notes: THREE PRESENTATION FIXES to what the last release introduced. No figure in your ledger changes and nothing needs re-running. THE PAYSLIP NOW SHOWS WHAT SSNIT WAS CHARGED ON. A payslip listed “SSNIT employee (5.5%)” without ever showing the pay that 5.5% was taken from — and it is never the gross pay printed above it. SSNIT is charged on pensionable pay, and that pay is now bounded by the Trust's insurable band, so an employee on GH¢90,000 saw a deduction of GH¢3,795 beside a gross of GH¢90,000, and 5.5% of 90,000 is 4,950. The figure was right and the document could not be checked. Payslips now carry an INSURABLE PAY (SSNIT BASIS) line under Gross pay, so the deduction can be checked against the line directly above it, and where the band moved that figure the payslip says why — capped at the SSNIT maximum, or raised to the SSNIT minimum. This was always imprecise, not only since the band: an employee with allowances has always had SSNIT charged on less than their gross. THE SSNIT AND TIER 2 SCHEDULES SHOW THE SAME FIGURE. Both listed a column headed “Pensionable pay” beside a contribution computed on the insurable earning, so for anyone at the ceiling the two did not multiply out. The column is now headed INSURABLE EARNING and shows the figure the contribution was actually computed on — and the Excel export, which already used it, now agrees with the screen. THE CURRENCY IS STATED ONCE ON EVERY SCHEDULE. The last release stated it once above the PAYE schedule but left SSNIT, Tier 2, the bank advice and the GRA sheet printing it on every figure as well, so those four said it twice over. All five schedules now declare it once and leave the figures alone. NO DATA CHANGES — this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
